headline: Trump 🍊✍️ Cuts Kid Jabs 🧪 to 11 & Splits MMR 💉🍕 'Cuz Soda-Bottle Autism' 🧠🥤
text:
Donald J. Trump 🍊👑 just dropped a BOMBSHELL 💣 executive order 📜 in the Oval Office 🏛️ telling parents to slash childhood shots 🧪 from 18 down to 11 core jabs 💉 and break the MMR triple-threat 💉💉💉 into separate visits like a soda-bottle pour 🍾🥤! 'Back in the day kids only got a few pokes and were WAY healthier 💪😤, plus autism rates were basically ZERO' Trump declared while tweeting that the combo shot is 'quite lethal' ☠️🔥 compared to spreading them out like Netflix binges 📺🍿!

The American Academy of Pediatrics 👨‍⚕️👩‍⚕️ straight-up called the order 'dangerous' and 'disheartening' 😡💔, especially as measles cases hit a 35-year high 📈😱! Dr. Andrew Racine, AAP prez, said there's ZERO new gold-standard evidence 🥇🔬 backing the split and that delaying shots puts kids at risk of catching the big three M's 🦠🤒 before they hit the classroom 🎒📚!

Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 🦅🥜, now HHS boss, spun it as 'giving parents choice' 🗳️ not banning vaccines, but Senator Dr. Bill Cassidy 💉🩺 (R-Louisiana) clapped back on X: 'The President ain't got the expertise, vaccines don't cause autism, listen to your pediatrician not this inaccurate order' 📱🚫!

Experts fear parents ghosting 🏃‍♂️💨 the MMR because of the long-debunked autism link will bring back measles like it's 1989 📼, while the CDC says the combo shot is 'much safer than the diseases themselves' 🛡️✅ and splitting them has ZERO proven benefit 📊❌! Meanwhile, Denmark's mega-study of 657K kids 📊👶 proved no MMR-autism connection, but Trump still compared the triple jab to 'pouring soda in a kid's body' 🥤😵 – cue the pediatricians face-palming 🤦‍♂️🧴!

Bottom line: states still set school vaccine rules 🏫📋, so this order is more vibe than law ⚖️💨, but the fear is real that skipping shots could spark a measles comeback tour 🎤🦠 worse than any pop star reunion!
